name: Iori
message: 「……There aren't really any good methods. What about this description？」
After school, I read through the materials on a bench. I need to broaden my knowledge even a little, for everyone's sake.

name: Iori
message: 「……Hmph！ This presence…！？」
I switch the materials for my Origami and stand up quickly.

name: Asahi
message: 「Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, I knew it！？ This sensation… it’s you again, Asahi！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, there’s something I absolutely need you to hear.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, of course, I don’t mind. It’s my job to listen to my students' consultations.」

name: Iori
message: 「But please, stop showing up with a ‘BOOM’ every single time.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m sorry, I just couldn’t suppress my overflowing passion.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, well, you’re an academy student now, so how about showing a little restraint?」

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s exactly why, Sensei.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I want you to accept these feelings of mine, sweet and overflowing like nectar, born of my adolescence.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, that makes it even worse！」

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, get off me, quickly.」
I nimbly lift Asahi up and sit her down next to me.

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa… My honey time has come to an end.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, what is this ‘honey time’… Anyway, didn't you have something you wanted to discuss with me？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I have something I’d like to consult you about.」

name: Asahi
message: 「……The truth is, lately Iori-sensei is rarely ever alone, and I find that very disappointing.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I know you have to instruct the Takamura Class members, but…」

name: Asahi
message: 「It’s so painful not being able to spend more time alone with you, Iori-sensei…」

name: Asahi
message: 「Lately, my training has even hit a wall.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m the reason for that！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, I was only joking.」

name: Asahi
message: 「However, it is true that my training has hit a plateau. That is why I wanted to ask for your advice.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course. I couldn’t just leave you to struggle on your own, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you so much...！」
It seemed this wasn't the kind of conversation she wanted others to overhear. Asahi looked visibly relieved.

name: Asahi
message: 「As part of my training, I’ve been sparring with everyone, but lately, I haven't been able to feel any real progress.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I think I’ve been making slow improvements regarding my offensive posture, just as you instructed, Sensei.」

name: Asahi
message: 「But even so, I still can’t hold a candle to Momiji-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see...」

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s why I get anxious and end up training too much. I know I’m verging on overworking myself, but...」

name: Asahi
message: 「I am sorry for breaking your instructions...」

name: Iori
message: 「No, it’s fine. I understand why you’re feeling anxious.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Victoria-san, Momiji-san, and so many others... they are all people with far more talent than I have.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I just don't see a future where I can keep training the way I am now and eventually beat them.」

name: Asahi
message: 「But I have no idea what else I should be doing...」
Asahi was more distressed than I had anticipated.

name: Iori
message: 「...Asahi, I’m sorry for making you feel this way. It’s my lack of strength as your instructor.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I believe Iori-sensei’s guidance is correct. I can feel in my skin that I have grown more than before.」

name: Asahi
message: 「But it’s frustrating that I’m the one unable to translate that into results. I just wish I had more talent...」
No matter how strong she becomes, it feels meaningless if she can’t overcome the wall directly in front of her.
That is likely what Asahi is thinking.

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, your dream is to become a Toujinegi, right?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, that’s right.」

name: Asahi
message: 「To become a Toujinegi, it will be impossible unless I can win against Victoria-san and Momiji-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Do I really have the strength to do that?」
What I can do to help Asahi realize her dream.

name: Iori
message: 「……Do you want to become that strong, Asahi?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I want to become strong.」

name: Iori
message: 「How much resolve do you have？」

name: Asahi
message: 「If necessary, I wouldn't mind giving my life for it.」
Those are words I don't want her saying lightly. But sometimes, a resolve of that magnitude is necessary.

name: Iori
message: 「There is… a way, I suppose.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Is that true…？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please, Iori-sensei, if there is a way… please teach it to me, I beg you…！」
She closes in on me with a desperate look on her face.

name: Iori
message: 「Honestly, it’s not a method I can recommend with open arms. And I don’t think it’s something you can master in a short amount of time, either.」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, this training might cause the form you’ve built up until now to fall apart and become useless.」

name: Iori
message: 「If it doesn’t go well, you could lose something important as a swordsman. That’s the kind of method it is.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even so, Asahi… are you prepared to do it？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I will do it.」
There was no hesitation in Asahi's response.

name: Asahi
message: 「I heard a little bit from Setsugekka-san. That to defeat the Suzakuin, you are taking a very difficult gamble.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I have the same… no, even more resolve than that.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, please instruct me in the method to defeat Momiji-san. I beg of you…！」
In that expression, I could see an unyielding determination.

name: Iori
message: 「……Alright, I understand.」

name: Iori
message: 「But let me tell you, it won't be easy.」

name: Iori
message: 「You can't expect any immediate results; I think it will be a long, painful training process, like walking through the darkness.」

name: Iori
message: 「Can you keep up？」

name: Asahi
message: 「It’s fine. If it’s something Iori-sensei is teaching me, I don't mind dedicating my entire life to it.」
I feel like the conversation is heading in a slightly strange direction… but oh well.
I believe I know better than anyone else the extent of Asahi's patience, perseverance, and diligence.

name: Iori
message: 「……This is for your ears only; it will be a secret training. Come to the training grounds alone at 21:00.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I understand...！」
